subject: Responsibility Radar + OKR Spotcheck: Launch Readiness (GTM, Enablement, Pricing, Docs, Support)
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-21T08:14:00-08:00
Subject: Responsibility Radar + OKR Spotcheck: Launch Readiness (GTM, Enablement, Pricing, Docs, Support)

Team —

Kicking off a condensed Responsibility Radar + OKR spotcheck ahead of the QBR leadership review next Friday. I want us to have a single, prioritized action grid we can present (2 slides): current readiness state, top risks, and irreversible blockers (if any). Attached: launch_playbook_v3.pdf and the working pricing matrix.

Quick status snapshot (one-line):
- GTM (Marissa): Yellow — demand plan complete; channel assets lagging (need 5 hero assets).
- Enablement (Monica): Yellow/Green — sales play trimmed for MVP; need two role-based cheat sheets.
- Pricing (Ben): Yellow — pricing bands ready, discount approval pending for strategic pilot.
- Docs (Marcus): Green — core docs published; product examples need final pass.
- Support (Grace): Yellow — L2 runbook draft ready; on-call rotations not yet finalized.

Top asks / action grid (owner — due):
1) Finalize hero marketing assets (Marissa) — due 2027-02-25
2) Deliver two role-based sales cheat sheets (Monica) — due 2027-02-24
3) Confirm pilot discount ceiling and sign-off path (Ben -> legal/procurement) — due 2027-02-23
4) Publish product examples and API quickstarts (Marcus) — due 2027-02-24
5) Lock on-call rotation + L2 escalation flow and attach to runbook (Grace) — due 2027-02-23

Risks to call out for leadership:
- If pricing discount path takes longer than 48 hours we miss Acme Corp procurement window (they're slotted for a pilot start 2027-03-01).
- Marketing asset delay reduces demo cadence for the sales pilot by ~30%.

Please reply inline with your specific confidence (Green / Yellow / Red) and any sub-tasks you want me to include in the slide. I will synthesize and circulate a 1-page slide for the leadership OKR check-in on Friday.

Attachments: [Attachment: launch_playbook_v3.pdf (PDF, 2.3MB)], [Attachment: pricing_matrix_q1_v2.xlsx (Excel, 180KB)]

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Launch Program Lead, GTM
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-21T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Responsibility Radar + OKR Spotcheck: Launch Readiness (GTM, Enablement, Pricing, Docs, Support)

Soojin — thanks. Quick updates inline:

- GTM confidence = Yellow. Demand plan is green; creative capacity is the limiter. I have two contractors who can take the hero assets -> need headcount approval (Kimberly, can you confirm budget cadence?).
- Marketing stereo: we can repurpose three existing one-pagers for the pilot, which buys us 72 hours.
- Enablement: we'll prioritize the AEs cheat sheet first; Monica, can you deliver a one-pager version by EOD Thursday and we will expand to the role-based versions?

Open question: do we want the pricing pilot to include a reseller discount tier? That would change packaging and docs. Ben, flag if that impacts timelines.

I'll also schedule a 30-min sync for Thursday to walk the slide and the action grid. Adding a calendar hold: Thu 2027-02-24 10:00-10:30 PT.

—Marissa
VP, Growth & GTM Operations

Looping in procurement and Acme contacts to confirm contracting runway.

Pricing update:
- Attached pricing_matrix_q1_v2.xlsx has the pilot band and two concession scenarios. Pilot discount ceiling we can approve internally up to 12% (rev impact modeled in sheet). Anything beyond 12% needs finance + CRO sign-off.
- Reseller tier will add ~2 business days for packaging and ~1 day for docs; recommend we NOT add reseller for initial pilot.

Action: Procurement (contracts@procureit.io), can you confirm standard PO timing and whether Acme requires a formal SOW before DocuSign? Emily, would you prefer SOW + PO or can we do a PO + appended SLA for the pilot?

Attachments: [Attachment: pricing_matrix_q1_v2.xlsx (Excel, 180KB)]

—Ben
Head of Revenue Operations
From: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@acmecorp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, ProcureIT Contracts <contracts@procureit.io>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-22T11:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Responsibility Radar + OKR Spotcheck: Launch Readiness (GTM, Enablement, Pricing, Docs, Support)

Hi Ben / team —

Thanks for the clarity. For Acme's procurement process: we typically need an SOW + PO for pilots where data access is involved. If you can provide a draft SOW and the proposed pilot SLA, Legal can usually turn around within 72 hours. PO timing depends on internal approvals but we are targeting start-week 2027-03-01.

Preferred: SOW first -> DocuSign. I can accept a Google Drive draft link in email (we'll route it to Legal).

Emily Zhou
Head of Strategic Partnerships, Acme Corp

Subject: Re: Responsibility Radar + OKR Spotcheck: Launch Readiness (GTM, Enablement, Pricing, Docs, Support)

Thanks all — good progress. Consolidated decisions / final action grid below (I'll convert to the leadership slide deck and circulate before Friday's OKR check):

Final decisions:
- Pricing: internal approval path set. Pilot discount ceiling = 12% (Ben). Ben to escalate beyond 12% to Finance/CRO. (Due: 2027-02-23)
- Contracting: Acme prefers SOW-first. Ben + Soojin will draft initial SOW; ProcureIT to confirm PO cadence. (SOW draft: 2027-02-24)
- Reseller: excluded from pilot to keep scope tight.

Updated action grid (owner — deliverable — due):
1) Marissa Cole — 5 hero marketing assets (3 repurposed + 2 new) — 2027-02-25
2) Monica Patel — AE one-pager (v1) + two role cheat-sheets (final) — 2027-02-24
3) Ben Carter — Final pricing + SOW input (sheet + draft SOW link) — 2027-02-24
4) Marcus Lin — publish API quickstarts and 3 product examples (link) — 2027-02-24
5) Grace Oconnor — finalize on-call rotation and attach L2 escalation to runbook (support_runbook_onsite.docx) — 2027-02-23

I've attached the support runbook draft for Grace to finalize: [Attachment: support_runbook_onsite.docx (Word, 120KB)].

I'll present these decisions and the one-page Responsibility Radar at the leadership OKR spotcheck on Friday. If anyone anticipates a miss on the dates above, flag it here today so I can adjust the slide.

Appreciate the quick turns.

Soojin Lee
Launch Program Lead, GTM
